archive.title: Exposition Park (Pittsburgh)
archive.caption: Exposition Park was the name given to three historic stadiums, located in what is today Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. The fields were used mainly for professional baseball and American football from c. 1879 to c. 1915.

archive.title: 1903 World Series
archive.caption: The 1903 World Series was the first modern World Series to be played in Major League Baseball.

archive.title: 1909 World Series
archive.caption: The 1909 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1909 season.

archive.title: 1960 World Series
archive.caption: The 1960 World Series was the championship series of Major League Baseball's (MLB) 1960 season.

archive.title: Three Rivers Stadium
archive.caption: Three Rivers Stadium was a multi-purpose stadium in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States, from 1970 to 2000.
